name: Congenital Scoliosis
definition: Spinal curvature caused by congenital vertebral formation or segmentation anomalies, often identified in infancy or childhood and sometimes associated with intraspinal or organ anomalies.

typical: Possible associated rib or vertebral anomalies

investigations.principle: Standing radiographs define deformity; CT may characterize bony anatomy; MRI screens neural-axis abnormalities when indicated.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Progressive deformity may need guided growth or fusion strategies in specialist centers.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Congenital Asthi-vikriti may be documented only as a parallel descriptive layer.

patientEducation.summary: Spinal curvature caused by congenital vertebral formation or segmentation anomalies, often identified in infancy or childhood and sometimes associated with intraspinal or organ anomalies.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
